versions.changelog:
Case skill versiond 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduced structured legal case search and retrieval functionality.
- Added multiple case type modules including corruption/bribery, finance (divorce/eat/steal), human injury, and traffic accident.
- Implemented workflow to identify and return the most relevant legal cases based on user scenarios.
- Provided formatdted, structured outputs for case details or indicated when no relevant case is found.
- Replaced general-purpose documentation with focused instruction for case search usage.
